entries.original_title: A TOMM40 variable-length polymorphism predicts the age of late-onset Alzheimer's disease
entries.original_authors: Roses, A; Lutz, M; Amrine-Madsen, H
entries.description: The polyT repeat (rs10524523) is associated with age at onset of late-onset Alzheimer's disease in APOE 33 and 34 individuals
entries.citation_sentence: In this study we attempted to replicate the recent report by Roses et al.12 that reported an association of APOE 3-TOMM40 polyT polymorphism (rs10524523) haplotypes are associated with age at onset and risk of AD.

entries.description: The very-long allele of rs10524523 is associated with increased risk for late-onset Alzheimer's disease
entries.citation_sentence: In this study we attempted to replicate the recent report by Roses et al.12 that reported an association of APOE 3-TOMM40 polyT polymorphism (rs10524523) haplotypes are associated with age at onset and risk of AD.
